verdict.rationale: Grafana is an observability platform, not an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. First-party docs state that AI agents connect through a fully hosted Cloud MCP Server or a self-managed open-source MCP Server, and a probe confirms an official MCP server repository at grafana/mcp-grafana. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connections, and documentation depth on the exposed tools and auth setup.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect AI agents to Grafana through the fully hosted Cloud MCP Server or the self-managed open source MCP Server.
official MCP server documented at https://github.com/grafana/mcp-grafana
